lines.speaker: A Wary Skaa
lines.text: You're the one who calmed the square down. Or riled it up, depends who you ask. Either way, folk are saying your name like it means something now.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: It doesn't have to mean anything. Not yet.

choices.text: "There's a place for people willing to fight, when the time comes."

lines.speaker: A Wary Skaa
lines.text: Fight who — the Lord Ruler? You're either mad or you mean it. I'll bring the ones who'll listen. Find us when you're ready.
